mutated.

This is the shared enforcement point for the security engine, Aegis reasoning
and any future workspace/tool gateway. It cannot be satisfied by a prompt
instruction or a plain email reply.

Creator public key and one-time challenge hash before any authority exists.

the configured gateway; the ED25519 signature proves the Creator approved.
A plain email reply cannot reach this path.
